Title: Can we trust genome-scale metabolic models?
Summary: Reviews how far genome-scale metabolic models can be trusted for intracellular flux prediction as they move into multi-scale and whole-cell modelling, covering automated curation, thermodynamics, and enzyme-constrained formulations.

Title: manylp: reproducible, exact, and batched linear programming for genome-scale dynamic flux balance analysis
Summary: Presents manylp, a solver workflow for reproducible, exact, batched linear programs that scale genome-scale dynamic flux balance analysis across many species and time steps.

Title: Curation of Gene–Protein–Reaction Associations Enhances the iPichia Genome-Scale Metabolic Model of Komagataella phaffii
Summary: Improves the iPichia genome-scale metabolic model of Komagataella phaffii by curating gene–protein–reaction associations that control model predictive performance.

Title: Analysis of metabolic interactions in an artificial consortium including butyrogenic gut microbes
Summary: Combines genome-scale metabolic modeling, cultivation, and transcriptomics to map cross-feeding in an artificial consortium of butyrogenic gut microbes.

Title: Integrated multi-omics and metabolic modeling links structure to function in high-performing electrosynthetic biofilm communities
Summary: Integrates multi-omics with metabolic modeling to connect community structure and function in high-performing CO2-to-chemicals electrosynthetic biofilms.

Title: Ensemble-Based Modelling of Optogenetic Bioprocesses under Phototoxicity
Summary: Develops ensemble hybrid models of optogenetic protein production in Komagataella phaffii that account for phototoxicity during light-controlled bioprocesses.

Title: Design-for-scale: Engineering strategies for robust microbial chassis to ensure good performance in industrial application
Summary: Reviews systems metabolic engineering principles for designing robust microbial chassis that keep performance from laboratory to industrial scale.

Title: Metabolic engineering strategies for sustainable de novo isobutylamine production by Corynebacterium glutamicum
Summary: Engineers Corynebacterium glutamicum for de novo isobutylamine production using metabolic engineering of decarboxylation and transamination routes.

Title: Artificial metabolic pathway for homoserine biosynthesis enables formaldehyde-dependent growth of Corynebacterium glutamicum
Summary: Constructs an artificial homoserine biosynthesis pathway that allows Corynebacterium glutamicum to grow in a formaldehyde-dependent manner.

Title: Combining Screening and Metabolic Engineering to Construct an Improved Rhamnolipid-Producing Pseudomonas aeruginosa Strain
Summary: Combines strain screening and metabolic engineering to improve rhamnolipid production in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

Title: A characterized promoter suite enables metabolic rewiring of the acetogen Acetobacterium woodii toward ethanol production
Summary: Builds a characterized promoter suite and modular plasmids to rewire Acetobacterium woodii toward ethanol production from C1 substrates.

Title: Engineering Cupriavidus necator for medium-chain-length polyhydroxyalkanoate production under two-stage fed-batch fermentation
Summary: Engineers Cupriavidus necator to express a Pseudomonas putida PHA synthase and accumulate medium-chain-length polyhydroxyalkanoate under two-stage fed-batch fermentation.
